Mutant Mania is recommended for players from Levels 80 to 100. It is the twelfth dungeon in the usual sequence. It is accessible from a Base Camp off Level 5 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Like most dungeons in the game, Mutant Mania consists of 7 levels with several sub dungeons. After the 7 regular levels is the Boss Lair. The Boss of Mutant Mania is Manglefeet.

The principal theme of the Quests offered for Mutant Mania centers around the theme of the Gym and Wrestling, with some obvious takeoffs of WWE. Loremaster Vraile says "I am embarassed to admit the violent brawls contained within the MutantMania are a guilty pleasure of mine. Embarassed because I am a seeker of knowledge, a learned man! And yet ... have you seen Babyface Buster perform his "Suicide Swaddle" attack? Pure poetry in motion! We must not simply read and listen, my child. Skilled observation may also grant knowledge."

DUNGEON DETAILS

Level 1

Cave Layout. Contains Cinder Hulk, Cinder Ranged Spitter. Toxic Venomspitter, Poison Berserker, Icy Fade General, Frosty Devastator!.

A very large and convoluted map.

NPC

UndercoverPancakes975 is found on Level 1. He is a Quest object.

Bernie's Backyard Brawl

Autumn Forest Layout. Contains Shadow Reaver, Sinister Ebon Phantasm, Searing Biggun, Chaos Hunter, Divine Fade General, Divine Devastator!.

Level 2

Cave Layout. Contains Cinder Hulk, Cinder Ranged Spitter. Toxic Venomspitter, Poison Berserker, Icy Fade General, Frosty Devastator!. A very large and convoluted map.

Level 3

Cave Layout. Contains Cinder Hulk, Cinder Ranged Spitter. Toxic Venomspitter, Poison Berserker, Icy Fade General, Frosty Devastator!. A very large and convoluted map.

NPC

Grapplin' Gertie is found in the gym located on Level 3. She is a quest object.

All-Amateur Assault

Crypt Layout. Contains Shadow Reaver, Sinister Ebon Phantasm, Searing Biggun, Chaos Hunter, Divine Fade General, Divine Devastator!.

NPC

Chairman Manchair will be found in the All-Amateur Assault. He will pay off on the Missing Ring quest line.

Level 4

Cave Layout. Contains Cinder Hulk, Cinder Ranged Spitter. Toxic Venomspitter, Poison Berserker, Icy Fade General, Frosty Devastator!. A very large and convoluted map.

Upper Umbrage Unleashed

Library Layout. Contains Searing Biggun, Sinister Ebon Phantom, Chaos Hunter, Shadow Reaver, Divine Fade General, Divine Devastator!, Embercore Thornlash, Embercore Drake.

Level 5

Library Layout. Contains Nasty Devastator!, Embercore Drake, Shadow Mutant Hulk, Shadow Mutant Puker, Divine Devastator!


Limitless Lower Locationals

Crypt Layout Contains Nasty Devastator!, Embercore Drake, Shadow Mutant Hulk, Shadow Mutant Puker, Divine Devastator!

Level 6

Library Layout. Contains Nasty Devastator!, Embercore Drake, Shadow Mutant Hulk, Shadow Mutant Puker, Divine Devastator!

NPC

Doctor Whom the Eleventh is both a quest object and a quest giver.

Level 7

Library Layout. Contains Nasty Devastator!, Embercore Drake, Shadow Mutant Hulk, Shadow Mutant Puker, Divine Devastator!


Sufficiently-Sized Scuffle

Catacombs Layout. Contains Embercore Thornlash, Ember Drake, Shadow Mutant Puker, Shadow Hulk, Nasty Destroyer, Toxic Fade Soldier, Ponderous Luchador.

Purpose Pondering Peak

Autumn Forest Layout. Contains Nasty Devastator!, Embercore Drake, Shadow Mutant Hulk, Shadow Mutant Puker, Divine Devastator!. A very twisted and convoluted map. As you follow the twists and turns you will begin climbing and reach the top of the Peak.

NPC's

Running through the forest you will find The Liger. Climbing to the top of the peak you will come to the camp of Logan the Liger.

Mutant Mania Massacre

Menacing Manglefeet the Murderous

Located off Mutant Mania level 7.

Antechambers Contain: Nasty Destroyer, Shadow Mutant Puker, Shadow Hulk, Lava Balrog, Shadow Howler, Manglefeet Fanatic and others, lots of Champions. Manglefeet and many guards are found in the Arena.

For tips on fighting Manglefeet, see the Manglefeet Boss Guide.
